describes: OpenAI Admin API GET /v1/organization/costs response saved as JSON (bucket_width=1d, group_by=line_item and project_id). Money only: no token quantities.

sources.covers: costs bucket fields object/start_time/end_time (Unix seconds, UTC)/results; result fields object 'organization.costs.result', amount.value (JSON number), amount.currency ('usd'), line_item, project_id; costs bucket_width only '1d'; group_by line_item; line_item examples 'ft-gpt-4o-2024-08-06, input', 'ft-gpt-4o-2024-08-06, output', 'evals | gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, input', 'assistants api | file search'
official reference page of the costs object (direct fetch returned HTTP 403; fields confirmed through the cookbook above)

unverified: line_item suffix vocabulary beyond ', input' and ', output' (', cached input' is ASSUMED to be cache reads)
non-token line_item names other than 'file search' (web search and code interpreter ASSUMED to be non-token costs)
amount.value precision (treated as a binary float: 15 significant digits)
provenance.notes: The model is the text before the last ', ' of line_item, after an optional '<product> | ' prefix. A line_item the rules do not recognize stays UNKNOWN (kept, never dropped).
